data.name: Silversmith
data.description: A vampire hunter learns the secrets of crafting silver into dangerous weapons. She adds a +%1 bonus on any Craft or Spellcraft check made to create a silver item that bypasses DR/silver, such as alchemical silver, silversheen, or silver weapon blanch.|InquisitorLVL
